race.title: Kelly's Dairy Soft Ice Cream Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: TOOTHLESS looked as good as ever when making a successful reappearance at Ffos Las last month so Paul Nicholls' consistent 8-y-o gets the nod to follow up at the expense of Cuban Court , who had a productive 2025/26 with 3 wins at this track and is fancied to come forward from his return. The enigmatic Primoz rounds off the shortlist. TOOTHLESS (FR) CUBAN COURT (IRE) PRIMOZ (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Toothless (11/8), Primoz (3/1), Bowmore (11/2), Il Ridoto (8/1), Jaipaletemps (8/1), Cuban Court (12/1)
